_comment: Per-stack hook configuration samples for the LE app. Rename to the per-stack filename (e.g. .claude/settings.json for Claude, .cursor/hooks.json for Cursor) and adjust paths.

hooks.description: Living-docs drift detection on docs/*.md edits (skills/living-docs-governance/SKILL.md)

cursor._note: Cursor uses a different hooks schema. See https://harness.example.com/hooks for the current shape; map PreToolUse and PostToolUse to the equivalent Cursor event names.

codex._note: Codex reads AGENTS.md as a system prompt; the equivalent of hooks is a 'system' block that calls the same scripts. Add a fenced code block at the top of AGENTS.md that documents the E7 baseline and the post-edit drift check.
codex.system_prompt_excerpt: Before every tool call, run python scripts/safeguard_hook.py. After every Edit on docs/**, run python scripts/living_docs_audit.py --workspace . --json.

generic._note: Generic shape; the harness should map PreToolUse and PostToolUse to its own event names.
